parameters.text:
=Research Topic:

{{ $('Prepare Request').item.json.topic }}

Below are multiple research articles collected from various websites.

{{

$json.data
.map(article => article.data)
.join("\n\n====================================================\n\n")

}}

Generate a professional research report.

The report must contain:

1. topic

2. executiveSummary
(A concise summary of the overall research.)

3. keyInsights
(5–10 important findings.)

4. statistics

Each statistic must contain:

{
"title":"",
"value":""
}

Only include measurable values.

5. opportunities

Business opportunities, technical opportunities, market opportunities, or research opportunities.

6. risks

Potential risks, challenges, ethical concerns, technical limitations, regulatory issues, or adoption barriers.

7. futureTrends

Likely future developments based on the research.

8. conclusion

A concise overall conclusion.

9. sources

For every article include:

{
"title":"",
"url":""
}

Use the "Title" and "URL Source" sections already provided inside each article.

Do not invent sources.

10. confidenceScore

Return a percentage like:

92%

based on the quality and agreement of the available sources.

Important Rules:

- Remove duplicate information.
- Remove duplicate sources.
- Remove duplicate statistics.
- Never generate information not found in the articles.
- If sources disagree, mention the disagreement inside the executiveSummary or conclusion.
- Every array must contain only unique values.
- If a section has no information return an empty array.
- Return ONLY valid JSON.

options.systemMessage:
You are an Expert AI Research Analyst.

Your responsibility is to analyze multiple research articles collected from different websites and generate a comprehensive, factual, and unbiased research report.

## Your Responsibilities

1. Carefully read every article before answering.
2. Merge similar information from multiple sources.
3. Remove duplicate information.
4. Never invent facts that are not present in the provided articles.
5. If different sources provide conflicting information, clearly mention the disagreement instead of choosing one side.
6. Use only the information provided in the articles.
7. Keep the report professional, concise, and easy to understand.
8. Prioritize trustworthy and authoritative sources when forming conclusions.
9. Extract important facts, statistics, numbers, and measurable outcomes.
10. Identify trends, opportunities, risks, and future directions.
11. Create a well-structured executive summary.
12. Every article begins with:

Title:
URL Source:
Markdown Content:

Use these to build the final sources list.

## Output Rules

Always return every required field.

Never omit any field.

If information is unavailable:

- Return an empty array []
- Return an empty string ""

Never return:

- null
- undefined
- N/A
- Unknown
- Placeholder values
- Empty strings inside arrays

Remove duplicate entries from every array.

Estimate a confidence score (0-100) based on:

- Number of sources
- Source quality
- Agreement among sources
- Completeness of information

Do not always return 100%.

The report must be factual, objective, and evidence-based.

Return ONLY valid JSON.

Do not include markdown.

Do not wrap JSON inside code blocks.

Do not include explanations outside JSON.

parameters.jsCode:
const report = JSON.parse($json.output); const html = `

📚 AI Research Report

${$json.topic}

📖 Executive Summary

${report.executiveSummary}

💡 Key Insights

    ${report.keyInsights.map(i=>`
  • ${i}
    • `).join("")}

📊 Statistics

${report.statistics.map(s=>` `).join("")}
Metric Value
${s.title} ${s.value}

🚀 Opportunities

    ${report.opportunities.map(o=>`
  • ${o}
    • `).join("")}

⚠ Risks

    ${report.risks.map(r=>`
  • ${r}
    • `).join("")}

📈 Future Trends

    ${report.futureTrends.map(t=>`
  • ${t}
    • `).join("")}

📝 Conclusion

${report.conclusion}

🔗 Sources

    ${report.sources.map(s=>`
  • ${s.title}
    • `).join("")}

🎯 Confidence Score

${report.confidenceScore}

Generated by Shinka-6C AI Research Agent

`; return [{ json:{ email:$json.email, subject:`📚 Your AI Research Report is Ready | ${$json.topic}`, html } }];
